description: This file defines the interface for the ARCv2 ARC Connect driver, including constants, data structures, and function prototypes for inter-core communication, debugging, and hardware control on ARCv2 architecture.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_cmd
methods.description: Sends a command with a parameter to the ARC Connect hardware via auxiliary register.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_cmd_data
methods.description: Sends a command with a parameter and data to the ARC Connect hardware.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_cmd_readback
methods.description: Reads the back value from the ARC Connect hardware.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_generate
methods.description: Generates an inter-core interrupt to a specified core.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_ack
methods.description: Acknowledges an inter-core interrupt from a specified core.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_read_status
methods.description: Reads the status of an inter-core interrupt for a specified core.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_check_src
methods.description: Checks the source of inter-core interrupts.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_clear
methods.description: Clears inter-core interrupt status.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_reset
methods.description: Resets debug state for specified cores.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_halt
methods.description: Halts specified cores for debugging.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_run
methods.description: Resumes execution of specified cores.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_mask_set
methods.description: Sets debug mask for specified cores.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_mask_read
methods.description: Reads debug mask for specified cores.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_select_set
methods.description: Sets debug select for specified cores.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_select_read
methods.description: Reads debug select state.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_en_read
methods.description: Reads debug enable status.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_cmd_read
methods.description: Reads debug command status.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_core_read
methods.description: Reads debug core status.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_clear
methods.description: Clears the global free-running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_read
methods.description: Reads the current value of the global free-running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_enable
methods.description: Enables the global free-running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_disable
methods.description: Disables the global free-running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_core_set
methods.description: Sets the core mask for the global free-running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_halt_read
methods.description: Reads the halt status of the global free-running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_core_read
methods.description: Reads the core mask associated with the global free-running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_enable
methods.description: Enables the interrupt distribution unit.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_disable
methods.description: Disables the interrupt distribution unit.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_read_enable
methods.description: Reads enable status of the IDU.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_set_mode
methods.description: Sets mode for a specific IRQ in the IDU.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_read_mode
methods.description: Reads mode for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_set_dest
methods.description: Sets destination cores for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_read_dest
methods.description: Reads destination cores for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_gen_cirq
methods.description: Generates a core interrupt request.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_ack_cirq
methods.description: Acknowledges a core interrupt request.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_check_status
methods.description: Checks the status of an IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_check_source
methods.description: Checks the source of an IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_set_mask
methods.description: Sets mask for an IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_read_mask
methods.description: Reads mask for an IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_check_first
methods.description: Checks if an IRQ is the first in sequence.
